hints.title: Middle Element Condition
hints.text: For a subarray of odd length L with middle element m, the sum of all elements must equal L * m.

hints.title: Fix Center Index
hints.text: Iterate over each possible center index c, and expand outward symmetrically by radius r.

hints.title: Check Centered Average
hints.text: Compute the sum of nums[c - r..c + r]. If sum == (2 * r + 1) * nums[c], increment the centered count.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing all symmetric odd-length expansions around each center.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Summing subarrays repeatedly without prefix sums takes cubic O(n^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix sum array allows O(1) subarray sum queries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects center expansion with prefix sum evaluation.
